name: pickup_handle_pkt11_spawn_delta
description: Pickup::HandlePkt11_SpawnDelta applies incoming pickup packet 11 create, remove, and hide/deactivate deltas against the primary pickup spawn list. Direct production host: RecoilApp.cpp.
known_limits: The smoke target covers the flag-1 create path and flag-2 remove path. The flag-8 hide/remove-object path is source-matched from Binary Ninja and relies on accepted ClearPickupFlagsRecursive, gwNodeSetRaycastable, gwNodeSetPickable, and Pickup::RemoveObject functional targets.
tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent Pickup packet-handler/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x433f40 validates lookup by packet pickupId in g_PickupSpawnList_Primary, flag-1 creation only when the spawn is missing, zero-filled PickupParsedZrdEntry construction, PickupType::GetByIndex from packet typeKeyIndex, amount/position/rotation/respawnDelay copy, SpawnFromParsedZrdEntry dispatch, overwriting the new spawn pickupId from the packet, SetNextPickupId(packet pickupId + 1), flag-2 removal of existing unreferenced spawns, flag-8 ClearPickupFlagsRecursive/raycastable/pickable clear plus RemoveObject, and return value 1.

The native smoke verifies a flag-2 packet removes the matching primary-list spawn and that a flag-1 packet creates a missing spawn from packet fields, overwrites its pickup id, and advances g_NextPickupId to packet pickupId + 1.
